# Paths where a change from a contributor outside the maintainers needs a
# recorded security review, even when the contributor is known (ADR 1221 in
# USAREUR-AF/goatcore). One glob per line: `**` crosses directories, `*` stays
# in one directory, a pattern with no slash matches that file name anywhere.
# Owners edit this file; it takes effect when the edit merges.
